findings.body: The Java compiler reports that no zero-argument overload exists, so the services module and the added tests cannot build or run.

findings.title: Fix the argument mismatch that prevents UsernameForm from compiling

raw_findings.body: fillContextForm is no longer called, so the conditional WebAuthn UI disappears from ordinary login; users whose only credential is a passkey cannot authenticate through these flows.
raw_findings.evidence: return webauthnAuth != null && webauthnAuth.isPasskeysEnabled() && user != null;
raw_findings.failure_mode: The login form is rendered without WebAuthn challenge data or conditional-passkey attributes.
raw_findings.impact: fillContextForm is no longer called, so the conditional WebAuthn UI disappears from ordinary login; users whose only credential is a passkey cannot authenticate through these flows.
raw_findings.root_cause: The new helper makes user identification a prerequisite for enabling conditional passkeys, reversing the previous initial-login condition.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Permit the enabled check when user is null so conditional passkeys remain available before identity selection, while applying any credential-specific filtering only when a user is already identified.
raw_findings.title: Do not disable conditional passkeys when no user has been identified yet

raw_findings.body: The helper enables the WebAuthn form solely from realm state, and the conditional authenticator bypasses the empty-authenticator check, so the user is offered an unusable passkey option.
raw_findings.evidence: return webauthnAuth != null && webauthnAuth.isPasskeysEnabled() && user != null;
raw_findings.failure_mode: Re-authentication renders a passkey flow that cannot successfully authenticate the selected account.
raw_findings.impact: The helper enables the WebAuthn form solely from realm state, and the conditional authenticator bypasses the empty-authenticator check, so the user is offered an unusable passkey option.
raw_findings.root_cause: The new predicate treats every non-null user as passkey-capable without inspecting that user's credentials.

raw_findings.title: Check that an identified user actually owns a passwordless WebAuthn credential
raw_findings.trigger: Re-authentication starts with an identified password-only user in a realm where passkeys are enabled.

raw_findings.body: The WebAuthn form is suppressed by the disabled realm policy regardless of the user's credentials, so the test cannot detect code that incorrectly offers passkeys to every identified user when the policy is enabled.
raw_findings.failure_mode: The test passes even if credential-specific gating is absent.
raw_findings.impact: The WebAuthn form is suppressed by the disabled realm policy regardless of the user's credentials, so the test cannot detect code that incorrectly offers passkeys to every identified user when the policy is enabled.
raw_findings.root_cause: The test changes both the per-user credential state and the realm-wide enablement condition instead of isolating the no-credential case.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Leave the realm passkeys policy enabled, ensure the selected user has no passwordless WebAuthn credential, and assert that re-authentication omits the passkey option; cover the disabled-policy case separately if needed.
raw_findings.title: Keep the no-passkey re-authentication test from disabling the feature under test
raw_findings.trigger: The test intended to verify behavior for an identified user without a passkey executes.

raw_findings.body: The newly added error-only branch can regress username hiding, registration disabling, challenge renewal, or recovery through password/passkey without a test detecting it.

raw_findings.root_cause: The patch adds re-authentication state restoration to the WebAuthn error path but adds tests only for successful WebAuthn submissions and password failures.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Add a re-authentication test that forces a WebAuthn error, verifies the re-authentication form remains scoped to the current user with passkeys available, and then completes with a valid password or passkey.

raw_findings.trigger: A prompt=login re-authentication submits a WebAuthn error or an invalid WebAuthn assertion instead of the successful assertions exercised by the added tests.
